description: This file contains CSS variables and styles for a themed front-end application, managing light and dark themes along with responsive design for mobile.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container class for the application with centralized text alignment and responsive background color.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the application, styled for a light or dark theme with flexbox layout.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Style for links in the application, adapting color based on the theme.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button class for toggling between light and dark themes, with hover and active effects.
